fix: Holding FUNC while turning D off converts the generated rhythm into ordinary trigs. The conversion copies and checks about 8 KB of track and lock data inside the Euclidean lock, which masked every interrupt (level 7) and so held off the audio render; the main outputs clicked, faintly even with the sequencer stopped. The lock now raises the interrupt mask to level 4 and never lowers it. Only the lock function in src/release-*/euclidean.c changes.

emulator.scope: Emulator only; not hardware evidence. Stock OS 1.53 (9bdd44bb…) and 1.54 (f78ba80f…) snapshots, MCF5441x instruction-timing model at 250 MHz with zero-wait memory.

interruptLevels.method: Interrupt-controller priority registers read from the stock 1.53 and 1.54 snapshots; contexts recorded by hooking the sequencer, both native event builders, the Euclidean event adapters and grid hooks during playback.
interruptLevels.sequencerAndEuclideanCode: Interrupt level 0 or 2; never inside the audio render

after.rendersStartedDuringEuclideanLocks: yes (the render is no longer held off)

conversionLock.limitation: The zero-wait model has no DDR or cache cost, so it underestimates the hardware duration of the 7.9 KB copy and compare; the emulator's codec output showed no glitch either way. The click itself is established by the hardware reports, not by the emulator.

regressions.note: Same pass counts as 1.1.5 on both OSes; the editing case includes FUNC + EUC-off conversion with the transport running.

emulator.coldBoot: Both all-mods SysEx files cold-boot to a settled UI; recaptured screenshots are byte-identical to 1.1.5's.

checklist: Audio track with a long sustained sound and a MIDI track, both with Euclidean on, playing: FUNC while turning D off on each gives no click and leaves the generated rhythm as ordinary trigs
The same with the sequencer stopped, and plain D off: silent
TRIG and FLTR leave Euclidean; FUNC + AMP reopens it
On at least one image: project save, reload and power cycle keep the Euclidean settings
hardware.configurations: All six mods together, and Euclidean alone, on each OS.
hardware.earlierReport: Before the fix, on 1.53: FUNC + D off clicked on the main outputs, faintly with the sequencer stopped; plain D off and FUNC + D with EUC already off were silent; with the master volume at zero there was no click.
limitations: Outcomes were reported for the checklist as a whole, not itemized per image.
Firmware was not read back from the device; build hashes identify the files provided for testing.
